title: 多後端物理：PhysX vs Newton MuJoCo Warp 的 Q1 掉落測試
title_en: Multi-backend physics: PhysX vs Newton MuJoCo Warp drop test with Q1
summary: 同一份 Q1 場景，分別用 isaacsim_physx 與 newton_mjwarp 跑掉落／站立測試，比較落地高度、接觸力與每秒步數，並學會用 PresetCfg 讓環境支援多後端。
summary_en: Run the same Q1 scene on isaacsim_physx and newton_mjwarp, compare settle height, contact forces and steps/s, and make an environment backend-selectable with PresetCfg.

params.label: 物理 preset
params.help: 跑兩次，一次選 Newton、一次選 PhysX，再比較 result.json。
params.help_en: Run twice—once with Newton, once with PhysX—then compare result.json.

params.label: 物理 dt（秒）
params.help: 1/200 s 是常見起點。太大的 dt 會讓接觸穿透、太小會慢。
params.help_en: 1/200 s is a common starting point. Large dt causes penetration; small dt is slower.

params.label: 初始高度（m）
params.help: 比 Q1 站姿略高，讓它落地後再觀察是否站穩。
params.help_en: Slightly above the Q1 standing height so you can watch landing and balance.

params.label: solver 迭代次數
params.help: PhysX 對應 solver_position_iteration_count；Newton MJWarp 對應 MuJoCo solver iterations。
params.help_en: PhysX maps to solver_position_iteration_count; Newton MJWarp maps to MuJoCo solver iterations.

references.title: Isaac Lab 3.0 — One environment, multiple backends
Transfer Policies Between PhysX and Newton

quiz.question: 在 3.0 裡，想讓 task 支援多種物理後端，環境設定應該放什麼？
choices: 兩份 env cfg 各自 import
sim.physics = 一個 PresetCfg 子類別，列出 isaacsim_physx / newton_mjwarp / default
在 __init__ 用 if/else 切換 import
只能在 CLI 選，程式碼不能表達
quiz.explain: PresetCfg 列出可選後端與 default；CLI 的 physics=NAME 會整段替換 sim.physics。
quiz.question_en: In 3.0, how do you make a task support multiple physics backends in the env config?
choices_en: Two separate env cfgs with different imports
sim.physics = a PresetCfg subclass listing isaacsim_physx / newton_mjwarp / default
CLI only; code cannot express it
quiz.explain_en: PresetCfg lists selectable backends and default; CLI physics=NAME replaces the whole sim.physics block.

quiz.question: Newton 後端的 ProxyArray 有什麼要特別注意？
choices: reset 後 buffer 可能重建，不要快取 .torch 結果跨 reset 使用
quiz.explain: Newton 是 auto-refresh、reset 時可能換 wrapper；PhysX 是 pull-to-refresh、buffer 穩定。兩者都應在每步重新取屬性。
quiz.question_en: What is special about ProxyArray on the Newton backend?
choices_en: After reset, buffers may be rebuilt—do not cache .torch across reset
quiz.explain_en: Newton auto-refreshes and may swap wrappers on reset; PhysX is pull-to-refresh with stable buffers. Re-read attributes each step on both.

quiz.question: 哪個後端不需要安裝 Isaac Sim 就能訓練？
quiz.explain: Kit-less 工作流程：Newton 物理＋Newton 渲染／GL 視覺化都不需要 Isaac Sim。PhysX 與 RTX 需要 --extra isaacsim。
quiz.question_en: Which backend can train without installing Isaac Sim?
quiz.explain_en: Kit-less workflow: Newton physics plus Newton/GL visualization needs no Isaac Sim. PhysX and RTX need --extra isaacsim.

quiz.question: PhysX 訓練好的策略能直接在 Newton 上跑嗎？
choices: 永遠可以，因為 API 相同
通常需要依官方 policy transfer 指南調整接觸／致動參數並重新驗證
只要 dt 一樣就行
quiz.explain: API 相同不代表動力學相同；官方提供 PhysX↔Newton 轉移指南與驗證範例，策略需重新評估。
quiz.question_en: Can a policy trained in PhysX run unchanged on Newton?
choices_en: Always, because the API is the same
Usually needs the official policy-transfer guide, contact/actuator tuning, and re-validation
quiz.explain_en: Same API does not mean same dynamics; the official PhysX↔Newton transfer guide expects re-evaluation, not free portability.

run.note: 每次執行只跑一個後端；把兩次 result.json 放在一起比較。
run.note_en: Each run uses one backend; compare the two result.json files side by side.
